title: Image picker in the newsroom: four options, reload, search target
description: The one interface editors use for stock and generated options, on a Story in the newsroom. Four options at a time. Pick one, or reload for four more. A text box for a search target, with a button to search. Editors can repeat until they find one or give up and move to the next kind of option.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan 2026-11-07: the picker must be built on the shared image operations (epic PPY-011174), not its own calls. Overlaps PPY-a52989; see project/wiki/image-toolchain.md section 8. The image-source interface in PPY-a36ac3 moves behind the shared image_search operation (build step 4, PPY-8553c6).
